text_en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler, and whoever is led astray by it is not wise.
text_cn: 清酒令人轻狂，醇酒使人发疯；凡沉溺于酒的，必不是明智人。

text_en: The dread anger of a king is like the growling of a lion; anyone who provokes him to anger forfeits life itself.
text_cn: 君王震怒，有如狮子的咆哮；触怒他的，危害自己的性命。

text_en: It is honorable to refrain from strife, but every fool is quick to quarrel.
text_cn: 平息争端，是人的光荣；凡是愚人，都喜爱争论。

text_en: The lazy person does not plow in season; harvest comes, and there is nothing to be found.
text_cn: 懒惰人一寒冷，便不耕作；收获之时，他必一无所获。

text_en: The purposes in the human mind are like deep water, but the intelligent will draw them out.
text_cn: 人心的谋略，有如深水，唯有聪明人，才能汲取。

text_en: Many proclaim themselves loyal, but who can find one worthy of trust?
text_cn: 自命为仁者，比比皆是；但有谁找到忠贞的人？

text_en: The righteous walk in integrity— happy are the children who follow them!
text_cn: 正义的人，必然为人正直；他的后代子孙，必然有福。

text_en: A king who sits on the throne of judgment winnows all evil with his eyes.
text_cn: 君王高坐在判座上，所有邪恶一目了然。

text_en: Who can say, “I have made my heart clean; I am pure from my sin”?
text_cn: 有谁能说：“我保持了心灵的洁净，我是纯洁无罪的？”

text_en: Diverse weights and diverse measures are both alike an abomination to the Lord .
text_cn: 不同的衡量，不同的升斗：二者皆为上主同样厌恶。

text_en: Even children make themselves known by their acts, by whether what they do is pure and right.
text_cn: 孩童的行为，洁净正直与否，由他的举动便可认出。

text_en: The hearing ear and the seeing eye— the Lord has made them both.
text_cn: 能听的耳朵，能看的眼睛：二者皆为上主所造。

text_en: Do not love sleep, or else you will come to poverty; open your eyes, and you will have plenty of bread.
text_cn: 不要贪睡眠，免得你受穷；两眼睁开，才能得饱食。

text_en: “Bad, bad, ” says the buyer, then goes away and boasts.
text_cn: 顾客常说：“不好，不好！”但一离去，赞不绝口。

text_en: There is gold, and abundance of costly stones; but the lips informed by knowledge are a precious jewel.
text_cn: 虽有大批黄金宝石，但最宝贵的，还是明智的唇舌。

text_en: Take the garment of one who has given surety for a stranger; seize the pledge given as surety for foreigners.
text_cn: 谁为外方人作保，拿去他的衣服；谁为异邦人作保，以他本人作质。

text_en: Bread gained by deceit is sweet, but afterward the mouth will be full of gravel.
text_cn: 骗来的食物颇觉香甜，事后口中却满是砂砾。

text_en: Plans are established by taking advice; wage war by following wise guidance.
text_cn: 运筹帷幄，必先要商讨；进行战事，必该凭智谋。

text_en: A gossip reveals secrets; therefore do not associate with a babbler.
text_cn: 游荡闲谈的，必泄漏秘密；张口饶舌的，别与他交结。

text_en: If you curse father or mother, your lamp will go out in utter darkness.
text_cn: 凡是辱骂自己父母的人，他的灯必在幽暗中熄灭。

text_en: An estate quickly acquired in the beginning will not be blessed in the end.
text_cn: 起初容易得来的财物，最后也不会得到祝福。

text_en: Do not say, “I will repay evil”; wait for the Lord , and he will help you.
text_cn: 你切不可说：“我以恶报恶”；应信赖上主，他必拯救你。

text_en: Differing weights are an abomination to the Lord , and false scales are not good.
text_cn: 不同的衡量，为上主所恶；不同的天秤，实属不道德。

text_en: All our steps are ordered by the Lord ; how then can we understand our own ways?
text_cn: 世人的脚步，由上主支配；人哪能了解自己的道路？

text_en: It is a snare for one to say rashly, “It is holy, ” and begin to reflect only after making a vow.
text_cn: 人若冒然说：“圣”，许愿后才反省，这是自投罗网。

text_en: A wise king winnows the wicked, and drives the wheel over them.
text_cn: 智慧的君王簸扬恶人，且用车轮来压轧他们。

text_en: The human spirit is the lamp of the Lord , searching every inmost part.
text_cn: 人的灵魂是天主的灯，探照肺腑的一切隐密。

text_en: Loyalty and faithfulness preserve the king, and his throne is upheld by righteousness.
text_cn: 仁爱和忠诚，是君王的保障；他的宝座，是赖慈爱而支撑。

text_en: The glory of youths is their strength, but the beauty of the aged is their gray hair.
text_cn: 少年人的光荣，在于他们的魄力；老年人的荣耀，在于他们的白发。

text_en: Blows that wound cleanse away evil; beatings make clean the innermost parts.
text_cn: 见伤的鞭打能清除邪恶，杖击能触及肺腑的深处。
